subject: Thursday forecast and the 06:00 call. Section 11.3
body:
Gale,

Latest aviation forecast for Thursday 09:00 to 12:00 along the route: sustained 19 mph, gusts to 31, trending upward through the morning. The contract line is sustained 23 or gusts 34. We are inside the envelope but not comfortably, and the trend is wrong.

Per Section 11.3 this is a joint call at 06:00 Thursday. I need your riggers' assessment and your recommendation, in writing, with names on it. Forty million people are planning to watch either way. What they watch is up to us.

One more thing: I know the week you are having. The decision cannot know it. Wind does not read the news.

Colleen Marsh
Director of Parade Operations, Harvest Parade Partners
